rca.rootCause: The `is_whitespace` class attribute is defined as `False` on the base `BaseSegment` class (in `src/sqlfluff/core/parser/segments/base.py`), but it is never overridden to `True` on the `WhitespaceSegment` and `NewlineSegment` classes. These segment types are defined in `src/sqlfluff/core/parser/segments/raw.py`, but they don't set `is_whitespace = True`, so all whitespace and newline segments incorrectly report `is_whitespace` as `False`.
evidence: The issue states: 'I expect segment.is_whitespace of a Whitespace token is True, however, it is set to False.'
The hint confirms the only definition found is `src/sqlfluff/core/parser/segments/base.py:72: is_whitespace = False`
The repo map shows segment type classes are defined in `src/sqlfluff/core/parser/segments/raw.py` (RawSegment and subclasses)
The test file `test/core/dialects/ansi_test.py` includes `test__dialect__ansi_is_whitespace` which asserts that segments of type 'whitespace' and 'newline' should have `is_whitespace` return True
The `WhitespaceSegment` and `NewlineSegment` classes in `raw.py` need to override `is_whitespace = True` to match their semantic type
